root_cause: The test downloads sample test data (bvlcalexnet-12.onnx) from storage.openvinotoolkit.org. The SSL socket connection was established but the data transfer stalled mid-stream and timed out after 180 seconds. All other 205 tests passed, indicating this is a transient network issue affecting the download of test data from the external storage server, not a code regression. The PR (37751) only modifies Dockerfile and docker_tag for GPU tests and is unrelated to this failure.
reproduction_steps: N/A - transient network timeout; not consistently reproducible outside CI.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed job - the issue is transient network connectivity to storage.openvinotoolkit.org
Consider adding retry logic in samples_common_test_class.py _requests_get() for network timeouts
Consider increasing the pytest-timeout value for tests that require network downloads
prevention_strategies: Add retry logic with exponential backoff in the _requests_get() wrapper function used for downloading test data. Pre-cache test data artifacts in the CI runner image or use a more reliable CDN/mirror.
